user.description: Where the library lives (metadata.json and the library folder). Keep it outside www: Home Assistant publishes www at /local/ without a login, so pictures there are public. Wall tablets get their pictures through each target's image entity either way.

logging_settings.title: Display Logging
logging_settings.description: Configure the shared log that the integration writes for the Frame TV Manager add-on.

data_description.logging_enabled: When enabled, the integration records how long each image is displayed.
data_description.log_retention_months: How many months of display history to keep before old entries are deleted.
data_description.log_flush_interval_minutes: How often buffered sessions are written to disk. Lower values mean faster updates but slightly more disk activity.

library_sync_settings.title: Library sync settings
library_sync_settings.description: Mirror the art library from GitHub (multi-home). Token: fine-grained PAT with read-only Contents access to the frame_art repo. Interval 0 disables the timer (poke-only).

add_tablet.title: Add a wall tablet
add_tablet.description: A wall tablet shows its picture through its Artwork image entity; nothing is sent to the device. Its screen counts as on while the showing entity is on.

data.tags: Image tags to include (a tablet with no tags shows nothing)
data.showing_entity: Showing art (on while the tablet shows the ambient picture)
